__[Formula I structure as originally disclosed]__

__wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11, R12, R13, R14, R15, R16, R17, R18, R19, R20, R21, R22, R23, R24, R25, R26, R27, R28, R29, R30, R31, R32, R33, R34, R35, R36, R37, R38, R39, R40, R41, R42, R43, R44, R45, R46, R47, R48, R49, R50, R51, R52, R53, R54, R55, R56, R57, R58, R59, R60, R61, R62, R63, R64, R65, R66, R67, R68, R69, R70, R71, R72, R73, R74, R75, R76, R77, R78, R79, R80, R81, R82, R83, R84, R85, R86, R87, R88, R89, R90, R91, R92, R93, R94, R95, R96, R97, R98, R99, and R100 are as defined in the specification,__

and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __wherein the compound of formula I is not an indole derivative having the structure disclosed in Schacht et al. US 4,069,338__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim __1 or 3__, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation __including__ acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation __including__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component __including__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle __treatment__.

10. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care __or__ improvement of the __condition__ of the skin or hair.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the __active ingredient according to__ Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __reduction__ of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for __reducing__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair __including reducing__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction __of__ the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
